reason: A DSH Web plugin that recalls commands and messages from the current session in the composer, allowing users to navigate, edit, and resubmit them with the Up and Down keys.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 编辑器中按上下键浏览当前会话的命令和消息历史，支持编辑后重新提交。
summaries.en: Browse current-session commands and messages in the DSH Web composer with the Up and Down keys, then edit and resubmit them.

capabilities: Reads current-session command and message history from the session log
Stores up to 100 recalled entries in in-memory per-session state
Intercepts eligible Up and Down key presses in the web composer
Writes recalled or edited text into the composer draft for user submission
